from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='bcdc0a0e3e4cc857dcb29367f4567b2a59926517';target=repo/'tests/test_apply_csv_queue_fairness.py'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base or git('rev-parse','origin/main')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
s=target.read_text()
anchor='''async def test_blocked_row_then_browser_leased_review_is_not_starved'''
if s.count(anchor)!=1:raise SystemExit('TEST_ANCHOR_MISSING')
before,after=s.split(anchor,1)
old='''rows=[SimpleNamespace(row={"status":"Pending","source":"greenhouse"}),
          SimpleNamespace(row={"status":"Pending","source":"greenhouse"})]'''
new='''rows=[SimpleNamespace(company="Fixture One",row={"status":"Pending","source":"greenhouse"}),
          SimpleNamespace(company="Fixture Two",row={"status":"Pending","source":"greenhouse"})]'''
if after.count(old)!=1:raise SystemExit('ROWS_ANCHOR_CHANGED')
target.write_text(before+anchor+after.replace(old,new,1))
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','--tb=short','tests/test_apply_csv_queue_fairness.py','tests/test_autopilot_blocked_job_fairness.py'],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=140)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('RESULT',p.returncode,o[-4800:],e[-900:],flush=True)
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('ACCEPTANCE_FAILED_NO_COMMIT')
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','tests/test_apply_csv_queue_fairness.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','test: cover leased browser continuation after blocked queue row'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('VERIFIED_PUSH',git('rev-parse','HEAD'),flush=True)
